reviews.title: International transfer delay
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with BOTIM’s international money transfer service.

I transferred money from my Mashreq UAE bank account to my own HDFC bank account in India for the first time. The transaction was supposed to be completed by 2 November, but even on 3 November, the status is still showing “Processing”.

The money has already been deducted, and I have not received a clear explanation of where my funds are or when they will reach my account.

This is someone’s hard-earned money, not a small matter. If a transfer cannot be completed, customers deserve a proper explanation and a timely refund.

I expect BOTIM to investigate my transaction immediately, provide a clear update, and either complete the transfer or return my money without further delay.

I also expect a response from the customer support team with a proper resolution, not just another generic assurance to wait.

Please take this complaint seriously.

reviews.title: Worst!
reviews.text:
Botim Developer! Yes, I have received a complaint reference number and promptly responded to your customer service team.

However, I question why additional identity verification, including a selfie holding my Emirates ID, is being requested when my account is already verified and my transaction history is readily available.

This is not my first transfer to the same beneficiary. I am both the sender and the beneficiary, as the receiving bank account belongs to me in my home country. These details can easily be verified through my BOTIM account and previous successful transactions.

Due to the delay, I have also requested cancellation of the transaction. At this point, I expect whichever resolution can be processed first: either complete the transfer and credit the funds to my beneficiary account or cancel the transaction and issue a full refund to my original payment account.

My main concern is that my money remains under processing without a clear explanation or definite resolution. FROM OCTOBER 30 9:39PM UNTIL THIS TIME.

I request that this matter be escalated immediately and that your team provide a concrete update and timeline for resolution.

As an existing customer, I expect prompt action, transparency, and accountability rather than further unnecessary delays.

I sincerely hope BOTIM can review this policy and provide a faster solution for cases like this.

reviews.text:
السادة/ فريق خدمة عملاء Botim المحترمين،

تحية طيبة وبعد،

أتقدم إليكم بهذه الشكوى الرسمية بخصوص سوء التعامل من قبل خدمة العملاء، وعدم تقديم المساعدة المطلوبة في الوقت المناسب، مما تسبب لي في خسارة مالية نتيجة عدم تمكني من تحويل أموالي بشكل عاجل.

كنت بحاجة ماسة إلى تحويل مبلغ موجود في بطاقة Botim إلى حساب بنكي آخر، ولم أكن أعرف الطريقة الصحيحة لإتمام عملية التحويل. لذلك تواصلت مع مركز الاتصال لديكم ثلاث مرات، وكنت أوضح في كل مرة أنني بحاجة إلى التحدث مع موظف يتحدث اللغة العربية لشرح المشكلة ومساعدتي في حلها.

في كل مرة كنت أُبلغ بأن موظفاً يتحدث العربية سيتواصل معي، ولكن للأسف لم يتواصل معي أحد. واضطررت إلى إعادة الاتصال مرة أخرى، وفي كل مرة كانت النتيجة نفسها دون الحصول على أي مساعدة فعلية

reviews.title: Cannot mute channels
reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 — Aggressive Ads You Cannot Turn Off

BOTIM has become incredibly frustrating to use.

I have disabled message notifications, muted the official BOTIM account, muted the Gold & Silver Investment account, and explicitly disabled article notifications. Despite all of this, BOTIM continues sending promotional push notifications advertising gold investments and other services.

There is apparently no setting to opt out of these marketing notifications while keeping legitimate call notifications enabled.

Users should not have to disable ALL notifications — potentially missing important calls — just to stop receiving advertisements. And putting an “ad-free” experience behind a paid subscription does not make aggressive, unavoidable push marketing acceptable.

Give users a simple, separate toggle:

Calls & messages: ON
Marketing & promotions: OFF

Until BOTIM provides a genuine opt-out for promotional push notifications, 1 star.

reviews.title: Some bugs, Poor video quality
reviews.text:
The app appears to prioritize monetization by displaying ads too aggressively.

During video calls, when the network connection is weak, there are instances where my own profile photo or self-video is displayed in the other participant's video window instead of showing their video. This creates a confusing user experience.

At the very least, when the network quality is poor, the app should stop loading or displaying advertisements. Showing ads consumes valuable bandwidth that could otherwise be used to maintain a stable and better-quality video call. Video call quality should take priority over ad delivery, especially under low-network conditions.

reviews.title: Botim money verification issue
reviews.text:
I have been using the same mobile number in botim since 2020. When I tried to verify my identity for BOTIM Money, customer service claimed that the number was registered under someone else’s name.

I provided official PDF copies of my Etisalat contract and monthly bill, including the contract bearing my signature. Surprisingly, their representative dismissed these documents as “screenshots,” even though they were official PDFs issued directly by Etisalat.

This email thread has continued for over a month, and I have decided not to waste any more time on such a frustrating verification process. I usually don’t leave negative reviews, but unfortunately, this experience deserves one star.

This situation has put me in a very difficult position and has seriously affected my daily life. It is unacceptable to block payments or restrict a card without a clear explanation or a prompt solution, especially for long-term customers who have trusted and supported your service.

I urgently request that Botim review my account and restore my card’s functionality immediately. I have been a loyal customer for years, and I expect a level of support that reflects the trust I have placed in your platform.

Please resolve this issue as soon as possible. If not, I will have no choice but to reconsider using your services in the future.

reviews.title: Provokes your privacy
reviews.text:
Be warned before installing this app! Even if you explicitly DENY the app permission to access your contacts during setup, it will still immediately notify people that you have joined. 

The moment you activate your account with your phone number BOTIM automatically scans the phone books of other users if anyone has your number saved on their phone they instantly get a push notification that you have joined  and you’re thrown into their online list without your consent, I was immediately bothered by an unwanted caller the exact second i activated the account. 

This is a massive privacy loophole that BOTIM is exploiting to reach more users on the expense of your privacy. I deleted the application after the damage was done! Protect yourself and don’t install the application as you will have to manually delete your profile afterwards. 

And for anyone who thinks the application is for free! It’s practically not for free whatsoever.. you are paying them by watching ads on every screen you open through the application what a pathetic scam!!

reviews.title: Not good app for texting
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for a while, but unfortunately it has several issues that need to be fixed:
	•	First, the Persian (Farsi) font is too small and This makes reading messages uncomfortable.
	•	Second, there is a serious problem with message status. Sometimes I send a message and the other person has clearly seen it, but the second check mark doesn’t appear. It looks like the message hasn’t been seen, which can easily cause misunderstandings.
	•	Another issue is with message order. When I reply to a message, my reply sometimes appears above the other person’s message instead of below it. This makes conversations confusing and hard to follow.
	•	Also, there is no option to delete your account. Once you create an account, you are forced to keep it forever, which is not acceptable for user privacy and control.

Overall, the app needs significant improvements in usability and basic functionality.

reviews.title: Worst service ever
reviews.text:
I am writing to express my serious dissatisfaction with the customer service provided by BOTIM regarding my wallet issue.

For the past 3 weeks, I have been facing a critical problem with my wallet account being suddenly restricted without any clear explanation. Despite submitting all the required documents and complying with every request from your side, there has been absolutely no progress or resolution.

What is even more frustrating is the level of negligence and lack of ownership demonstrated by your customer service team. I have had to call countless times just to follow up on my case, repeatedly explaining the same issue to different agents with no consistency, no proper updates, and no accountability.

Additionally, the responses I receive via email are unclear, overly complicated, and do not address the core issue. Instead of providing solutions, they only add confusion and delay.

During my last call, I specifically requested clarification on why my wallet account was restricted, especially as I have always been a responsible and active user. The agent was unable to provide any proper explanation. When I escalated the matter and asked to speak with a manager, I was promised a callback the following morning. However, as expected, no manager has contacted me even after 3 days.

This clearly reflects:
- Zero credibility in commitments  
- Zero customer centricity  
- Zero genuine support  

After 3 weeks of waiting, continuous follow-ups, and unfulfilled promises, it

reviews.title: Avoid This Service – No Communication at All
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with this service. My transfer has been delayed far beyond the expected time,its over a week now as we speak n I don’t know how many months it will go on. 
And what makes it worse is the complete lack of communication.

I have tried calling their support number multiple times and sent several emails, but received no meaningful response or update. For a service that handles urgent money transfers, this level of silence is unacceptable.

The money was clearly needed urgently, yet there has been no transparency, no timeline, and no proper customer support. At this point, it feels like customers are left completely in the dark once the transaction is initiated.

I strongly advise others to think twice before using this platform, especially for urgent transfers. Customer service and reliability are just as important as the transaction itself, and unfortunately, this experience has failed on both.

reviews.title: BOTIM Money Transfer
reviews.text:
This is very first time I am rating any app in my phone. If I had option to give minus I would have gladly done. 
I did botim money transfer for the very first time trusting the fastest remittance but it’s been 12days. No money credit to my recipient account and no refund back. Not even proper update on what happened. 
Calling and emailing back to back just to get an update. Very poor service. No one is sure what to reply the customer especially who is asking about their OWN money. Even after frequently asking to respond to my email on the status on MY MONEY it took 10days to for one agent to understand the struggle and at least give a reply though it says ‘we are still working on resolving the issue’. 
No timeline on when I can get my money. One agent says 2 days after 2 days other says again 2 days then next says 72 hours and then end of today but when its today still says out backend team is working!!! 
No proper communication. No proper problem resolution. Day after day the customer had to call back to back and beg for an answer.

reviews.title: Money transfer
reviews.text:
I’ve been using BOTIM for a long time, and honestly, it has become one of the most disappointing apps for international remittance. There are so many apps today that offer free transfers, better exchange rates, faster delivery, and actual rewards for users but BOTIM has provided zero benefits for me till now.

Most of my friends also feel the same. If other apps can give free international transfers and cashback, why is BOTIM still charging fees and offering nothing in return? In 2025, users expect transparency, low charges, and real value but BOTIM is still far behind.

It’s very frustrating to see newer apps like Aspora and others giving completely free remittance with instant transfers, better customer support, and smoother user experience, while BOTIM continues without any improvement.

Honestly, for anyone looking to save money and get better service, I strongly recommend uninstalling BOTIM and switching to alternatives that actually care about customers. BOTIM needs to seriously upgrade itself if it wants to stay relevant.
